opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members (Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow). Postgraduate, Full and Fellow applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support member engagement at the Society's own meetings and, where funding allows, attendance at Society-sponsored events. Covers registration for up to three meetings with one application, attendance at meeting dinners, and a contribution toward advanced standard travel and accommodation on presentation of receipts.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education. Applications for 2026 are closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award. Applications should be physiological in nature.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Applications for 2026 are closed and will reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events. The next application round is open, closing 28 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who are members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential. Funds may be used for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other justifiable sundries (not staff salaries). The next application round is open, closing 28 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion principles in the physiological sciences, in either teaching or research. Applications have closed for 2026 and will reopen in 2027.
